$comment: nixd workspace config: gives completion and hover for `my.*` in host files,
resolved from the real evaluated option set rather than guessed.
nixd 2.x does NOT read this file itself: it takes these settings from the
editor. The Doom config (R0K0R/doom-emacs, my/nixd-json) reads this file
and answers nixd's workspace/configuration request with it.
nixd MUST RUN WITH IFD DISABLED. Pointing it at a full host eval otherwise
doom-intermediates build from the editor -- once measured at 226 minutes,
and it fires on file open, not on demand. The nixd installed by
features/dev-toolchain is wrapped to do that. The only thing lost is
galaxybook4-pro360 is used as the reference host because it enables nearly
every feature, so nearly every option is reachable. Options a host does not
